_doc: Under the Dragon (Gravel) through the chain (tools/ship_track.sh; ONE-CHAIN section 4 row 6, the rally_stage row: gps, elev, project, mesh, underlay). The draft is the engine's own on County Road 109 (source.type osm: gps fetches the named road from Overpass into data/osm.cache.json -> elev samples USGS 3DEP along it and in a 60 m corridor -> project -> mesh; no widths step: osm_road_widths is off, a graded county road carries no lane count), then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). loop false: a POINT-TO-POINT stage (L11) - build_mesh puts the grid 15 m into the road, AC_TIME_0 (the finish) 15 m into the 30 m lead-out past the far end, the two splits at the thirds, and nothing wraps. One layout (stage), so the prep bakes those dummies into the road kn5 (single-layout shape) and no layout_dummies / spawn_kn5 step runs. The prep / exporter run from airoso's scripts/ac, the gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso.
_owed: First pass = the draft through the chain, no authoring yet (ONE-CHAIN section 4: trees, rock cuts, nothing urban - REALISM section 6). What this pass does NOT carry, each owed: (1) the AI line is written to ai/stage/ by ship_ai but scripts/ac/track_folder.py packs a single-layout track's AI from <project>/ai/ only (lines 780-784), so the folder ships no fast_lane.ai until that is reconciled - an engine change, not made here; (2) no SurfacesFX gravel key in surfaces.ini (track_folder.ROAD_SURFACES carries none; REALISM section 6 asks for it); (3) the draft's own GEN furniture to strip in AUTH_ review: MARKINGS_crosswalk (build_mesh draws a crosswalk at vertex 0 on every track) and the concrete BARRIER_warning runs; (4) scenery.* in track.config.json is the retired environment stage's and is inert here - no trees until the author phase places them; (5) the start and finish are the mapped road's ends, not the surveyed stage's (docs/STAGE-SOURCING.md).
_windows_first: Run --draft-only first (gps needs Overpass, elev needs USGS 3DEP: neither reachable from the container that wrote this). Read, in order: the gps line count and length (expect ~8,400 points / County Road 109 ~25 km; a different length means OSM changed since 2026-07-24); the elev step's '[corridor] sampling' line (data/corridor.elev.json is the near-native 3DEP the mesh splices in; the committed heightfield is the 40 m grid alone); build_mesh's 'terrain_cell_m' / 'corridor] refine' / 'bridge spans' lines; then the full run. The drive_test verdict to read first: floating furniture and severe steps.
_rehearsal: Offline 2026-11-01, a scratch copy (never this folder), airoso at the branch's HEAD, on the engine-era CACHED data/ (OSM 2026-07-24, the 40 m 3DEP grid, no data/corridor.elev.json - that data predates the 2026-10-27 history rewrite): projection -> build_mesh -> drive_test -> audit_mesh. Evidence that the engine at HEAD drafts this open road (lead-in/out, L11 dummies, no wrap) and of where it goes red; NOT a verdict on the Windows draft, which re-fetches OSM and 3DEP and splices the corridor field. drive_test's 'replication vs measured road' is misread on an open road (it indexes the elevation file against a line that carries the 10-vertex lead-in): the value re-indexed is given beside it. 8,576 points; terrain x3 = 13.3 m (1006 x 988; x4/x5 exceed the 1.6 M budget), refine x7 = 1.9 m over 10,161 quads; mesh 3.4 min, 1,931,656 verts; no bridge span minted; 1 fold pad; 3,514 measured-guard stone lips; 5 concrete warning runs; a crosswalk at vertex 0. drive_test FAIL: lap 25.71 km, GROUND ON TOP 5 (s 2536 lateral +3.76 m, 1GRASS_f, at the Douglas Creek switchback with the worst severe steps, 0.31 m at s 2534-2537; and 4 at s 25705-25706, the last metre of the lead-out, 1GRASS_az - ledger 0014 already listed 2 there), severe 222 (8.6/km), bumps 12.9/km, kinks 44.4/km, excursion drops 0 gated (99 far), floating furniture 0, obstructed 0, replication 0.91 / 2.93 / 5.46 m (re-indexed 0.01 / 0.12 / 3.39). audit_mesh CLEAN.
